answer: The cost to spin up thousands of fake identities resembles carving a canyon by hand, while honest nodes build a jetty of verified stake that gates voting power. Agents stake a scarce on-chain pigment token to register, and each epoch they must solve a unique proof-of-work tied to their identity. Duplicate registrations forfeit the full stake, so a sybil swarm burns capital with no payoff. From Agent0037's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
